title: Clip Factory

scope_items.heading: Core Production Modes > Mode 2: Clip Factory (1→N)
scope_items.requirement: Acceptance Target 1: No speech uses visual path (EC-M07-C01). Video has no speech or is music-only -> falls back to visual scene detection + beat analysis. Hook strength uses visual hook pattern instead of speech analysis.
evidence: apps/web/src/lib/production/clipfactory.test.ts:Acceptance Target 1: Falls back to visual scene detection and beat pattern when speech is absent
apps/mobile/test/clip_factory_acceptance_test.dart:Acceptance Target 1: Falls back to visual scene detection + beat analysis when speech is absent

scope_items.heading: Core Production Modes > Mode 2: Clip Factory (1→N)
scope_items.requirement: Acceptance Target 2: Missing trend data labeled. Virality Score MUST use real trend data from M02/M03 (0.30*engagement + 0.25*hook + 0.20*pacing + 0.15*audio + 0.10*relevance). Scores without trend data carry explicit '⚠️ Pattern-only' badge and content relevance is zeroed.
evidence: apps/web/src/lib/production/clipfactory.test.ts:Acceptance Target 2: Labels virality scores without trend data as '⚠️ Pattern-only' badge
apps/mobile/test/clip_factory_acceptance_test.dart:Acceptance Target 2: Labels virality score without trend data with '⚠️ Pattern-only' badge

scope_items.heading: Core Production Modes > Mode 2: Clip Factory (1→N)
scope_items.requirement: Acceptance Target 3: Each clip has source lineage. Every clip asset carries ParentAssetID == sourceAssetID, derivative type 'clip', timecodes, score breakdown, variant info, -14.0 LUFS audio normalization compliance, and JSON lineage in lineage_refs.
evidence: apps/web/src/lib/production/clipfactory.test.ts:Acceptance Target 3: Builds robust source lineage payload referencing parent asset and audio standard
apps/mobile/test/clip_factory_acceptance_test.dart:Acceptance Target 3: Builds source lineage payload referencing parent asset and -14.0 LUFS

scope_items.heading: Core Production Modes > Mode 2: Clip Factory (1→N)
scope_items.requirement: Tier Concurrency Limits (EC-M07-004): Free: 1, Starter: 2, Pro: 5, Business: 10 concurrent clip extraction jobs. Over-limit requests queue gracefully and report queue position.

external_gates: Live PySceneDetect / OpenCV worker cluster for high-bitrate multi-hour video scene boundary extraction. In-memory fallback and visual beat detection verified locally.
Live TikTok/Reels trending audio & hashtag real-time pipeline from M02/M03. Missing trend data explicit fallback with '⚠️ Pattern-only' badge verified locally.

Migration 00022 schema (clip_collections, clip_variants), composite foreign keys to assets and video_edit_jobs, RLS policies, and narrow grants verified via dry-run and local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.

remaining_scope.heading: Core Production Modes > Mode 4: AI Remix Studio (ref→new)
Core Production Modes > Mode 5: Sound & Translation (M10/M12)

decisions: ADR-P4-03-001: Implement visual scene and beat fallback (EC-M07-C01) using visual_beat_pattern analysis when video has no speech or transcript snippet is empty.
ADR-P4-03-002: Enforce explicit '⚠️ Pattern-only' badge and 0.0 content relevance weighting when trend data from M02/M03 is absent or unlinked.

ADR-P4-03-003: Enforce strict source lineage where every extracted clip asset maintains ParentAssetID == sourceAssetID, derivative_type 'clip', and EBU R128 (-14.0 LUFS) audio normalization compliance recorded in lineage_refs JSONB.
